Product Features

  • Luxurious, modern style The simple but elegant shape with decorative ribs on the fronts is a must for lovers of modern design. The metal base adds lightness to the design, and the whole is completed by decorative handles in gold. With its symmetrical, fluted design and smooth lines, this chest of drawers will add a real accent to your home.
  • Functional drawers: The two drawers offer enough storage space for your cosmetics, jewellery and other accessories to keep your dressing table tidy.
  • Space-saving: Due to its compact size, this dressing table fits perfectly in any bedroom and does not take up much space. The drawer cabinet is 57.5 cm above the floor, so a stool can be placed under the table.
  • Sturdy Construction: The dresser has been designed to be a durable piece of furniture as it has been made of high-quality wood material and an excellent rail, all for comfortable use.
  • Easy installation: The dressing table is quick and easy to assemble, so you can set it up in your bedroom without much effort. Color Notes: Please note that the colors in the online images of the items on your home monitor may differ from the original colors.
